title: Benowitz placed in a mental health facility

tellings.quote: So they actually put him in a mental health facility for like a month or so

plain: In the 1980s an Albuquerque man named Paul Bennewitz, who had become consumed by beliefs about aliens, was put in a mental health facility "for like a month or so." A researcher and writer named Greg Bishop tells Michels this without naming a source, in an episode about how the alien story broke Bennewitz's mind.
